headline: On November 12, 2020: PlayStation 5 launches in select countries
captionCards: PS5 launched alongside Xbox Series X/S in November 2020
It began the ninth generation of home video game consoles
instagramCaption:
PlayStation 5 hits stores on November 12, 2020.

The new console launched in Australia, Japan, New Zealand, North America, and South Korea.
It was announced as the successor to the PlayStation 4 in April 2019.
A surprising detail: it arrived alongside Microsoft’s Xbox Series X/S in the same month.
Its release marked the start of the ninth generation of video game consoles.
